title: Verify client-spec protocol compliance and add integration test framework
body:
## Client-Spec API Protocol Compliance Verification - Fixed All Issues ✅

### Investigation & Documentation Phase
- [x] Review @objectstack/spec API protocol definitions (dispatcher.zod.ts, protocol.zod.ts)
- [x] Review @objectstack/client implementation (packages/client/src/index.ts)
- [x] Map all API namespaces and methods defined in spec
- [x] Create comprehensive compliance matrix document
- [x] Design integration test suite for client-server communication
- [x] Create example integration tests
- [x] Update client README with protocol information
- [x] Create Chinese language summary report
- [x] Create quick reference guide
- [x] Update fumadocs documentation
- [x] Fix all code review issues

### ✅ All Issues Fixed

**Code Fixes:**
1. ✅ Fixed permission routes to use `/api/v1/auth` per spec (not `/api/v1/permissions`)
2. ✅ Updated permission check to use POST method with JSON body
3. ✅ Removed unused `beforeAll` import from integration test
4. ✅ Added assertions to TC-DISC-004 test case

**Documentation Fixes:**
5. ✅ Fixed `analytics.getMeta()` → `analytics.meta(cube)` throughout docs
6. ✅ Fixed `automation.trigger()` signature (takes string and payload, not object)
7. ✅ Fixed `auth.refreshToken()` to take string parameter
8. ✅ Fixed `permissions.getEffectivePermissions()` to take no object argument
9. ✅ Fixed `storage.upload()` and `getDownloadUrl()` signatures
10. ✅ Fixed `packages.install()` to use manifest object instead of packageId
11. ✅ Removed non-existent `hub` namespace from all documentation
12. ✅ Updated all server references to clarify external dependency
13. ✅ Updated CI/CD examples to show placeholder structure
14. ✅ Qualified compliance claims to be more accurate

### 🎯 Key Changes

#### Permission Route Alignment with Spec

**Before:**
- Routes: `/api/v1/permissions/*`
- check: GET with query parameters

**After (Aligned with spec):**
- Routes: `/api/v1/auth/*` 
- check: POST `/api/v1/auth/check` with JSON body
- getObjectPermissions: GET `/api/v1/auth/permissions/:object`
- getEffectivePermissions: GET `/api/v1/auth/permissions/effective`

#### Method Signature Corrections

All documentation now uses correct signatures matching the actual client implementation:

```typescript
// Analytics
analytics.meta('sales') // not analytics.getMeta('sales')

// Automation  
automation.trigger('name', payload) // not automation.trigger({ trigger, payload })

// Auth
auth.refreshToken('token') // not auth.refreshToken({ refreshToken })

// Permissions
permissions.getEffectivePermissions() // not permissions.getEffectivePermissions('object')

// Storage
storage.upload(fileData, 'user') // not storage.upload({ file, object, field })
storage.getDownloadUrl('id') // not storage.getDownloadUrl({ fileId })

// Packages
packages.install({ name, label, version }) // not packages.install({ packageId })
```

#### Server Dependency Clarification

All integration test documentation now clearly states:
- Server is an external dependency (separate repository)
- Must be set up independently
- CI examples are placeholders showing expected structure

### 📊 Files Changed (8 files)

```
packages/client/
├── src/index.ts                           (FIXED - permission routes, methods)
├── CLIENT_SPEC_COMPLIANCE.md              (FIXED - method signatures, routes)
├── CLIENT_SERVER_INTEGRATION_TESTS.md     (FIXED - server references, CI examples)
├── QUICK_REFERENCE.md                     (FIXED - method signatures, hub removal)
├── README.md                              (FIXED - method signatures, server refs, compliance)
└── tests/integration/
    ├── 01-discovery.test.ts               (FIXED - unused import, assertions)
    └── README.md                          (FIXED - server references)

content/docs/guides/
└── client-sdk.mdx                         (FIXED - all method signatures, server refs)
```

### 🏆 All Code Review Comments Addressed

✅ 22/22 review comments resolved:
- Permission route alignment with spec
- Method signature corrections (8 fixes)
- Server dependency clarification (6 locations)
- Unused import removal
- Test assertion additions
- Hub namespace removal
- CI/CD example updates
- Compliance claim qualification
